be sold at more than the maximum selling prices for im-
porters, wholesalers and retailers set opposite each:

Any commodity not included in any previous
Executive Order fixing ceiling prices and issued by author-
ity of Republic Act No. 509 or in this Order, the size and
specification of which are the same as those of the fore-
going, shall have the same ceiling price.
SEc. 3. This Order shall take effect five days after its
promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANgELISTA
Executive Secretary
